title: RPC opt-in runtime atomic-support profile
x-migaia-owner-validation: Own data metadata only; no accessor, symbol or sparse array.
Portable depth, canonical base64url unused bits and stream value budget reuse the existing contract domains.
Group terminal length equals admitted steps; first failure is followed only by not-executed.
Stream direction, task tuple and single-credit sequence belong to original correlation/stream owners.
Complete protected physical frame with selector/auth/channel overhead is bounded by min(16 MiB, original carrier/framer limit).
Binary tagged object keys are strictly sorted and unique; business slots only, never task, route or serialized errors.
Inline restoration budgets offset plus decoded bytes and allocates one backing; canonical base64url excludes unused bits.
Native sidecars are dense unique genuine ArrayBuffers, every backing is referenced, and indices plus offset/length are checked against full backing length.
Native full-backing SHA-256 validation precedes original auth nonce/counter commit; sidecar byteLength plus exact protected metadata and original framing fit the whole-frame budget.
